quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026: revenue RM'000 186,906, up approximately 19% year-on-year on higher contributions from Malaysia and Taiwan; the Taiwan subsidiary's revenue rose 7% (18% on a New Taiwan Dollar basis) as semiconductor volume increased on higher demand and strong orders from customers in Taiwan; PAT up 44% or RM15.9 million. 1H26 revenue RM376.7 million, 30% higher, with the Taiwan subsidiary up 9% (19% in NTD) and PAT up 41%.

quarterly_data.signal: Prospects: the semiconductor industry continues to be supported by long-term structural demand from artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, automotive electronics and advanced manufacturing; while customers remain measured in their capital spending, Frontken continues to enhance technical capabilities, expand its service offerings and invest in capacity, and remains optimistic about the semiconductor industry's growth prospects.
